Assistant Professor (Maîtresse de Conférences) in Statistics at **AgroParisTech** since september 2023.\
*MMIP dept (Modélisation Mathématique, Informatique et Physique), UFR de Mathématique*\
Research at **UMR MIA Paris-Saclay** (Mathématique et Informatique Appliquées).

Formerly PhD at Centre of Geosciences and Geoengineering, Mines Paris (2020-2023).

# Research

An incomplete list of research topics I'm interested in:

-   Spatio-temporal statistics
-   Stochastic Partial Differential Equations
-   Deep generative models
-   Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs)

# Teaching

I teach statistics at the undergraduate and graduate levels, with a focus on:

- Linear and nonlinear models
- Machine learning
- Spatial statistics
- Bayesian statistics

I teach in the engineering program at [AgroParisTech](https://www.agroparistech.fr/).

I also contribute to master's programs at Université Paris-Saclay, including [Mathematics for the Life Sciences (MSV)](https://sites.google.com/view/m2-msv/programme/descriptif-des-cours/apprentissage-statistique-pour-les-donn%C3%A9es-environementales?authuser=0) and [Biodiversity, Ecology and Evolution (BEE)](https://www.universite-paris-saclay.fr/formation/master/biodiversite-ecologie-et-evolution).

Finally, I teach in the master's program AgroParisTech-University of French Guiana [Biodiversity, Ecology and Evolution (BEE) program](https://umr-ecofog.cirad.fr/enseignement/master-2-bee/presentation), in Kourou, French Guiana.
